nodes.description: Address of the external Ferrum bot protection contract invoked via low-level calls in checkBots, distribute and list.
Privileged owner address assigned from tx.origin in the XDEFI constructor; gate for delegate, distribute and list.
Uniswap pair address computed in constructor via pairOf and passed into the bot protection calldata.
Public balance mapping mutated in transferFrom, distribute and list without SafeMath.
Public allowance mapping; set to uint(-1) in constructor and manually decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply (240e24) used to compute the owner allocation in list.
Uniswap V2 router interface used to add liquidity in list.
WETH address constant used when deriving the pair address.
Modifier that performs an external low-level call to botProtection before executing the guarded function body.
Constructor of BotProtected storing the bot protection address.
XDEFI constructor setting owner from tx.origin, computing uniPair and granting unlimited allowances.
Payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; updates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function executing arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address and calldata.
Internal pure function deriving the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2-style keccak hashing.
Owner-only airdrop that calls botProtection then overwrites balances in an unbounded loop.
Owner-only listing function that sets balances, adds liquidity with a timestamp deadline and calls botProtection.
Caller controlled address used for access checks, transfers and approvals.
Timestamp used to build the Uniswap liquidity deadline.
Origin address used as owner and given unlimited allowances in the constructor.
Low-level .call to botProtection executed inside the checkBots modifier before state updates.
Arbitrary delegatecall executing external code in the contract storage context.
Low-level .call to botProtection made before balance mutations in distribute.
Low-level .call to botProtection made before balance mutations in list.
External call to routerForUniswap.addLiquidityETH transferring ETH and tokens.
Arithmetic on block.timestamp (block.timestamp + 600) used as a liquidity deadline.
Constructor parameter holding the bot protection contract address.

Spender address parameter of approve.

First token address parameter of pairOf.
Second token address parameter of pairOf.
Recipient array parameter of distribute and list, forwarded to the bot check.
Fixed amount assigned to every recipient in distribute.
Liquidity amount parameter of list.
Per-recipient amount array parameter of list.
Boolean result of the delegatecall in delegate.
Boolean success flag of the botProtection call in checkBots.
Return bytes of the botProtection call in checkBots.
Loop index used in distribute and list.
